lines.t: This world has sold its soul for comfort
Painted sin in holy colors
And called it worship
But I do not change
Whole world drunk, fornicate with the system
Call evil culture, put messiah in the mix
Then take his name lightly, praise mixed with filth
Church is full of noise, but empty of truth and guilt
Bow to the pagan, dress it up holy
Golden calves renamed, so the lie looks lowly
Great commandments say grace got me covered
But truth don't bend just cause lies feel comforted
You shout his name while you walk in sin
That ain't faith, that's blasphemy within
You mingle light with darkness, honor with shame
And wonder why heaven don't answer your prayers the same
You can't carry fire with hands full of lies
You can't claim the vine while the fruit still dies
Vessels of honor or vessels aflame
Choose who you serve, I do not share
Modern Pharisees write doctrine in stone
Set themselves up like thrones of their own
Say here we grow from the true vine
But your fruit tastes bitter every single time
You twist the word till it bleeds confusion
Call tradition truth, mass delusion
Dry branches bragging about connection
But fire don't lie in inspection
Wrath of the lamb knocking at the door
You thought he wouldn't speak anymore
Thought silence meant approval from heaven
No judgment moves on appointed seconds
Rich or poor, bond or free
Lawless hearts all judge equally
You were made for honor but chose vanity Now sin stacked high like identity
I am a jealous God, great in power And I do not change
Holidays dipped in pagan blood Rebranded lies called Christian love
Commandments swapped for comfort and hype Man's opinion crowned over eternal right
Prayers rejected, cause ears hate law
Scripture twisted, till truth got flaws
Babbling sermons, no holy fear
God says, be silent, I'm calling you out right here
The harlot dressed the church in gold
Let her astray, may sin feel bold
But she'll be stripped, left barren, broken
Crushed by the Holy One, word spoken
You can carry fire with hands full of lies
You can't claim the vine while the fruit still dies
Vessels of honor or vessels of flame
Choose who you serve
I do not change
I do not change
I do not change
